name: HANRO
band_note: no priced staple; Swiss underwear and sleepwear brand; its 'shirts', 'bigshirts', pants and dresses are knit lounge/sleep pieces, so only the cotton tee quali
why: Swiss-founded women's and men's underwear, bras, camisoles and sleepwear in cotton, wool and silk (Cotton Seamless briefs $55, camisoles about $115), sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Liestal, Switzerland in 1884 by Albert Handschin; Carl Ronus.

ownership.owner: HUBER Holding AG (HUBER Holding Group, Austria)

quote.q: As pioneers in circular knitting, Hanschin & Ronus produced the finest undershirts on specially developed machines.

opview: “As pioneers in circular knitting, Hanschin & Ronus produced the finest undershirts on specially developed machines.” — HANRO (house), History of Hanro, hanrousa.com

facts_read.source: brand site (US and global); hanro.com legal notice; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database
